raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On gfx950, DeepSeek-V4.1 prefill / extend rows run wo_a as `torch.einsum`. Its group-major result costs wo_b a flatten copy, and wo_b then quantizes it to MXFP8 in a separate pass that slows down once the input leaves the cache. A Triton GEMM with the quant in its epilogue is slower than hipBLASLt at these sizes (about 825 vs 1250 TFLOP/s), so the GEMM stays on hipBLASLt and this PR removes the copy and the slow quant.

## Modifications

- New `wo_a_prefill_matmul` (`deepseek_v4_gfx95_dense.py`): the hipBLASLt bmm writes straight into wo_b's token-major [T, G, R] layout (a strided `out=`, so no flatten copy), then one `fp8_grid_quantize` pass produces wo_b's `Mxfp8Activation` (fp8 codes + ue8m0 scales). With a bf16 wo_b it returns the token-major bf16.
- `_apply_wo_a_bf16_matmul` uses it for V4.1 prefill / extend rows at every group count (TP2, TP4, DP-attn). Decode / verify are unchanged; deterministic and batch-invariant modes keep today's path.
- It runs only when `torch.version.hip` >= 7.15 (ROCm 10). The hipBLASLt bundled with torch's ROCm 7.2 wheel miscomputes this strided-output bmm at many shapes (for example 2 groups × 1024 rows, 4 × 640, 8 × 129), so on ROCm 7.2 `wo_a_prefill_matmul` declines and today's einsum path runs unchanged.

## Accuracy Tests

Operator check on MI355X, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261025` (torch 2.11.0+rocm10.0.0, HIP 7.15), G = 2 / 4 / 8, dense and 64-head-padded `o`:

| check | result |
|---|---|
| token-major bmm vs today's einsum (bf16) | bitwise at every row count 1-1100, every 13th to 8192, and 7 counts up to 65536 (8265 shapes) |
| fp8 codes and ue8m0 scales vs wo_b's own quant of today's bf16 output | bitwise for every 32-group with amax >= 1e-10 (all bf16 amax values checked); all-zero groups get a different scale byte, codes stay 0 |
| wo_b output vs today, aiter MXFP8 GEMM (all rows) and FlyDSL MXFP8 GEMM (>= 2048 rows) | bitwise at 1-32768 rows (75 points, two GPUs with different seeds), also against an unpatched container |

On `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm724-mi35x-20261025` (HIP 7.2) the function declines at every shape, and wo_a's and wo_b's outputs are bitwise equal to main's.

GSM8K (`sglang.test.few_shot_gsm8k`, 1319 questions, parallel 64), DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash TP2 + DSpark, MI355X x2, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261018`, this design before the version gate was added:

| | run 1 | run 2 |
|---|---:|---:|
| base | 0.893 | 0.891 |
| this PR | 0.903 | 0.902 |

The GSM8K spread is the server's run-to-run nondeterminism.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MI355X x1, `lmsysorg/sglang-rocm:v0.5.22-rocm10-mi35x-20261025`, CUDA-graph replay (median, mean of two GPUs), `TRITON_HIP_USE_ASYNC_COPY=0 TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT=1 SGLANG_OPT_HIP_FLYDSL_MXFP8=1`. wo_a plus its quant for wo_b, us (before → after):

| rows | TP2 (G = 4) | TP4 (G = 2) | DP-attn (G = 8) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 10.3 → 10.3 | 8.3 → 8.2 | 18.5 → 18.6 |
| 128 | 23.1 → 18.1 | 17.1 → 12.5 | 33.6 → 27.3 |
| 1024 | 77.1 → 66.9 | 40.4 → 34.7 | 90.1 → 72.8 |
| 2048 | 85.7 → 67.8 | 75.8 → 66.2 | 164.4 → 129.9 |
| 4096 | 146.4 → 114.6 | 73.3 → 72.7 | 342.9 → 278.9 |
| 16384 | 637.9 → 514.9 | 256.2 → 250.6 | 1324.9 → 1028.5 |
| 32768 | 1270.3 → 990.8 | 514.8 → 496.0 | 2466.9 → 1897.2 |

Including wo_b's GEMM, us:

| rows | TP2 (G = 4) | TP4 (G = 2) | DP-attn (G = 8) |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 16.3 → 16.2 | 11.9 → 11.9 | 29.3 → 29.4 |
| 128 | 36.4 → 31.2 | 26.1 → 21.6 | 52.5 → 46.5 |
| 1024 | 118.2 → 108.4 | 63.5 → 57.7 | 164.5 → 149.4 |
| 2048 | 135.1 → 118.4 | 104.3 → 95.0 | 255.3 → 224.3 |
| 4096 | 260.1 → 212.9 | 127.4 → 126.4 | 541.0 → 472.7 |
| 16384 | 929.4 → 812.6 | 432.7 → 424.0 | 1874.9 → 1590.8 |
| 32768 | 1849.7 → 1604.9 | 841.0 → 819.5 | 3489.7 → 2938.1 |

Per 16K chunk of one request (layers 0-19 at 16384 rows, layers 20-39 at 128 rows), that is TP2 −2.56 ms, TP4 −0.20 ms, DP-attn −6.06 ms per rank (−2.44 / −0.26 / −5.80 ms including wo_b).

On ROCm 7.2 this PR keeps today's path (same kernels, same speed as main) because of the hipBLASLt strided-output bug above.

## Checklist

- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.mxfp8_amd_gfx95 import (
     Fp8GridActivation,

 )
+from sglang.srt.batch_invariant_ops import is_batch_invariant_mode_enabled
 from sglang.srt.environ import envs

@@ -255,3 +257,30 @@ def wo_a_fp8_grid_matmul(
     if fp8_grid:
         return Fp8GridActivation(y)
     return y.view(o.shape[0], wo_a.shape[0], wo_a.shape[1])
+
+
+# hipBLASLt before HIP 7.15 (ROCm 10) miscomputes a bmm into a strided out= at many shapes
+_STRIDED_BMM_OUT_OK = _is_hip and tuple(
+    int(v) for v in torch.version.hip.split(".")[:2]
+) >= (7, 15)
+
+
+def wo_a_prefill_matmul(o: torch.Tensor, wo_a: torch.Tensor, emit_fp8: bool = False):
+    """Prefill wo_a as a token-major bmm (wo_b's layout, no flatten copy); with emit_fp8 it
+    returns wo_b's MXFP8 input. None before HIP 7.15 or in batch-invariant / deterministic
+    mode."""
+    if (
+        not _STRIDED_BMM_OUT_OK
+        or is_batch_invariant_mode_enabled()
+        or get_exec().deterministic.enable_deterministic_inference
+        or not (o.dtype == wo_a.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and o.stride(2) == 1)
+    ):
+        return None
+    T, G, _ = o.shape
+    R = wo_a.shape[1]
+    y = torch.empty((T, G, R), dtype=o.dtype, device=o.device)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        torch.bmm(o.transpose(0, 1), wo_a.transpose(1, 2), out=y.transpose(0, 1))
+    if emit_fp8:
+        return Mxfp8Activation(*fp8_grid_quantize(y.view(T, G * R)))
+    return y
